title: Store Safely: Rural Firearm Injury Prevention for Families
official: Store Safely: Rural Firearm Injury Prevention for Families
summary: The researchers are testing a firearm safety prevention strategy tailored for families with children who reside in a rural area. Researchers hypothesize that the intervention will lead to improvements in household firearm storage.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Provision of signed and dated informed consent form
* Age 18 or older
* English-speaking
* Have a child under 18 living at home
* Currently keep at least one firearm on their property
* Reside in Michigan's Upper Peninsula (U.P.)
* Access to a computer/mobile device and wifi
* Have sufficient information about household storage to complete surveys

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to be consented in English
* Under the age of 18
* Lack of firearm on their property
* No child in the home
* Residence outside the U.P.
* No access to technology
* Previously enrolled in 2020 pilot project
* Previously access the Store Safely website
